title: Extract the language-neutral bounded MSBuild expression core
outcome: F# semantic evaluation delegates property expansion and condition evaluation to a reusable language-neutral core with no behavior change.
acceptance: F# routes every semantic property expansion and Import/Choose condition through the shared core with existing causes, limits, and results preserved.
Focused F# evaluator tests, full repository gates, and one dual-agent adversarial review pass.
The shared core owns scalar property expansion, condition parsing/evaluation, reserved safe intrinsic dispatch, cancellation, and existing expression bounds.

completion.summary: Extracted and validated the reusable bounded MSBuild scalar-expression core; F# delegates all property and condition evaluation through it with stable behavior.
